base_generator_output: ref refs/regen/base on GitHub (regenerate with scripts/regen/regen.sh)

patches.reason: Jira issue search with --agent returned only 'id' because 'summary' wasn't in the keep-fields map. Also added field promotion from nested 'fields' sub-object to flatten Jira issue responses.
patches.validated_outcome: keen find-issues --agent now returns key, summary, status for each issue.

patches.reason: Agents must re-export JIRA_CLOUD_PLATFORM_USERNAME/PASSWORD env vars in every shell invocation. Config file fallback eliminates this friction.
patches.validated_outcome: keen doctor passes when credentials are in ~/.config/keen/auth.json and env vars are unset.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Generator should emit config paths matching the CLI binary name, not the internal project slug
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Default config path is ~/.config/keen/ which doesn't match the 'keen' binary name

patches.summary: Add find-issues, transition, sprints, get as top-level command aliases.
patches.reason: Most-used commands have 40-60 char paths (e.g. jira-cloud-platform-search and-reconsile-issues-using-jql-post). Aliases save agent tokens and reduce errors.
patches.validated_outcome: keen find-issues, keen transition, keen sprints, keen get all resolve correctly.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Generator should support alias definitions in the spec or a sidecar config
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Aliases are per-CLI customizations that should survive regeneration without a local patch file

patches.summary: Add `keen release sync` to record git release tags as Jira versions and Fix Versions.
patches.reason: Releases were cut in GitHub only, so Jira had no versions and no issue carried a Fix Version. This joins git history to Jira, which no single API endpoint does.
patches.validated_outcome: Unit tests cover key extraction, first-containing-release mapping, add-never-replace, the next rename and re-run idempotence; a backfill dry-run over 82 tags matched git tag --contains on 5 spot-checked keys.

patches.summary: keen-mcp reports itself as keen with the release version; unstamped builds say dev.
patches.reason: The generator left keen-mcp announcing 'Jira Pp Cli' 1.0.0 to every MCP client, and both binaries defaulted to 1.0.0, so a local build claimed to be the old release.
patches.validated_outcome: MCP initialize returns serverInfo name keen with the stamped version; go build without ldflags prints 'keen dev'.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Generator should use the CLI name and a stamped version in the MCP server and the default version
deferred_to_upstream.reason: The slug-derived display name and a hardcoded 1.0.0 survived the rename

patches.summary: keen-mcp uses the CLI's config lookup; JIRA_CLOUD_PLATFORM_URL sets the base URL.
patches.reason: newMCPClient passed an explicit config.toml path, which skipped the auth.json lookup in config.Load. JIRA_CLOUD_PLATFORM_URL was documented but read nowhere.
patches.validated_outcome: Clean-HOME credential matrix: auth.json, cloud_platform_* config.toml, and both env layouts pass for keen and keen-mcp.

patches.summary: Add keen wiki create-page, get-page and update-page on the Confluence v2 API.
patches.reason: Atlassian removed content create/read/update from the Confluence v1 spec, so the generator cannot produce them. Agents fell back to raw urllib calls.
patches.validated_outcome: Live: created a page in a test space, update-page moved it to version 2 then 3, get-page returned the new body; drafts stay at version 1 as Confluence requires.

patches.summary: Wrap plain-string rich-text fields into ADF before Jira v3 writes.
patches.reason: Jira v3 rejects a string comment body, worklog comment, description or environment. The generated flags take them as strings.
patches.validated_outcome: keen issue comment add KEY --body 'text' posts (201); ADF passed via --stdin is unchanged. 1.4.1: create-bulk wraps issueUpdates[].fields too; a bulk-created story with a plain-text description kept its literal headers and held in Selected for Development.

patches.reason: Specs declare no cursor or has-more field for startAt endpoints, so --all returned page 1 only (95 commands).
patches.validated_outcome: get-all-sprints 216 --state closed --all returns 209 of 209; get-all-boards and project search match REST totals.

patches.summary: Promoted no-argument commands reject stray positional words.
patches.reason: keen projects create silently ran GET /rest/api/3/projects/fields and ignored 'create'.
patches.validated_outcome: keen projects create exits 2 with: did you mean "keen project create"?

patches.summary: keen search uses GET /rest/api/3/search/jql with a text ~ query.
patches.reason: The generated live search called /rest/api/3/search, which Atlassian removed (HTTP 410), with a q parameter Jira never read.
patches.validated_outcome: keen search 'release sync' returns live KEEN issues.

patches.summary: Root help text and tools-manifest.json name the tool keen.
patches.reason: Generated text still said 'Manage keen resources via the keen API' and api_name jira-pp-cli.

patches.summary: Old command and MCP tool names keep working after Atlassian spec changes.
patches.reason: The October 2026 specs retire 21 APIs (Admin v1 directory, app access settings, workflow transition properties) and move the org policy commands to atlassian-access-policies. Without this, 30 commands and tools would vanish.
patches.validated_outcome: All 1,091 v1.2.2 commands and all 1,114 v1.2.2 MCP tools still resolve; retired ones name their replacement.

patches.reason: Generator 4.15 emits c.GetNoCache(path, nil) against a client whose method takes ctx first, so the tree does not build.

patches.summary: Typed-table parent-id columns are nullable, and their tests expect inserts without a parent id to succeed.
patches.reason: Made by hand in May 2026 (partial sync data has no parent id). scripts/regen/postfix.py applies it to tables and tests that a regeneration adds.

patches.summary: Async commands poll Atlassian's documented progress endpoint, pinned in scripts/regen/normalize.py.
patches.reason: The generator guessed the status endpoint differently on each run, often wrongly (bulk edit polled linkedWorkspaces), and used {taskId}, which jobs.go never fills in.
patches.validated_outcome: A second regen on unchanged specs merges with no changes.

patches.summary: --output-summary writes large output to a private temp file and prints a JSON summary; --select checks its paths and no longer leaks siblings of a missing nested field.
patches.reason: Agents pay for every byte keen prints (one issue read is about 25 KB). A mistyped or absent nested --select field used to print the whole object through the list-envelope fallback.
patches.validated_outcome: keen get on a 25,400-byte issue with --output-summary prints a 170-byte summary; --select fields.summery exits 2 with a suggestion; fields.parent on an epic warns and prints 100 bytes.
